description: This file defines classes and functions for a WebBridge SDK, including a JSON-RPC client, service registration, and WebSocket communication management.

classes.name: JsonRpcClient
classes.description: Handles JSON-RPC communication over WebSocket, including request sending, response handling, and message reception.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a service with methods that can be registered and invoked via JSON-RPC.

classes.name: ServiceManager
classes.description: Manages multiple services, handles WebSocket connections, and facilitates service registration and communication.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the WebSocket connection for the JSON-RPC client or service.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request with specified method and parameters.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a notification message via WebSocket.

methods.name: _onIncomingMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages and resolves corresponding promises.

methods.name: registerMethod
methods.description: Registers a method with a specific name and version within a service.

methods.name: _callMethodByName
methods.description: Invokes a registered method by its name with provided parameters.

methods.name: registerService
methods.description: Registers a new service with the ServiceManager and initiates connection.

methods.name: _connectService
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection for a specific service.

methods.name: _controllerActivateService
methods.description: Sends a request to activate a service via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: _sendResponse
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC response over WebSocket.

methods.name: _controllerCloneService
methods.description: Clones a service via JSON-RPC request.
